title: Slow-import warnings cannot be tied to a deploy
evidence: Closed by decision 2026-11-26 (Brad: "go with your recommendations" on "Two server items to close"): no change. The server has no release at runtime (instrument.server.mjs sets none; SENTRY_RELEASE is a Docker build arg scoped to the build step), and a fix would need a runtime env var or a workflow change, with docs/privacy-app-addendum.md. The App lab import slow event (app/lib/app-routes.server.ts) keeps its allow-list without release (US-52 AC7d, PR 1268).
